2608.21712.title: ATHENA: Knowledge-guided agentic neural architecture search for AutoFormer-based electronic health record modeling
2608.21712.paper_summary: Transformer-based models are widely used for clinical prediction from electronic health records (EHRs), yet their architectures still require substantial manual tuning, and the optimal configuration may vary across tasks and hospitals. Neural architecture search (NAS) automates architecture design, but conventional methods are computationally costly for Transformer-based EHR models. Recent large language model (LLM)-guided NAS methods reduce manual search design but typically conduct each search independently, without reusing architecture knowledge across hospitals. In this study, we propose ATHENA (Agentic Transfer across Hospitals for EHR Neural Architecture Search), a knowledge-guided agentic NAS framework for Transformer-based EHR modeling. ATHENA uses a weight-sharing supernet that is pretrained once per hospital, allowing candidate architectures to be instantiated as inherited subnetworks and evaluated through fine-tuning rather than independent pretraining. It also incorporates a two-layer cross-hospital architecture prior. The first layer retrieves high-performing architecture examples from source sites based on task descriptors, while the second estimates the effects of architectural components using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based meta-regression. These priors guide a multi-agent LLM search together with validation feedback from the target hospital. Across six clinical prediction tasks and two independent health systems, ATHENA matches or outperforms four NAS baselines in 9 of 12 hospital-task evaluations at a search budget of 30. It also shows more consistent architecture selection across repeated searches. ATHENA provides a practical approach for reducing manual architecture tuning in Transformer-based EHR modeling. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/GatorAIM/ATHENA.
2608.21712.paper_summary_zh: 基於Transformer的模型廣泛應用於從電子健康紀錄（EHR）進行臨床預測，但其架構仍需大量手動調整，最佳配置可能因任務和醫院而異。神經架構搜索（NAS）自動化架構設計，但傳統方法對於基於Transformer的EHR模型計算成本高昂。最近的由大型語言模型（LLM）引導的NAS方法減少了手動搜索設計，但通常獨立進行每次搜索，而不重用跨醫院的架構知識。在本研究中，我們提出了ATHENA（跨醫院的EHR神經架構搜索的代理轉移），這是一個知識引導的代理NAS框架，用於基於Transformer的EHR建模。ATHENA使用一個權重共享的超網絡，該網絡每個醫院預訓練一次，允許候選架構作為繼承的子網絡實例化，並通過微調而非獨立預訓練進行評估。它還納入了一個兩層的跨醫院架構先驗。第一層根據任務描述從源站點檢索高性能架構示例，而第二層則使用基於SHapley加法解釋（SHAP）的元回歸估計架構組件的影響。這些先驗引導多代理LLM搜索，並結合來自目標醫院的驗證反饋。在六個臨床預測任務和兩個獨立的健康系統中，ATHENA在30的搜索預算下，在12個醫院任務評估中有9次與四個NAS基準匹配或超越。它還顯示出在重複搜索中更一致的架構選擇。ATHENA為減少基於Transformer的EHR建模中的手動架構調整提供了一種實用的方法。代碼可在 https://github.com/GatorAIM/ATHENA 獲得。
